# solid-v1.5

solid-v1.4 where short pairs kept only for their contrast must be a thin 1px line on both pixels (fixes arch outlines;
costs some smoothing on figure outlines).

Status: **superseded** (replaced by a newer version, kept so older packs can be rebuilt)  
Changes in this version: Short pairs kept only for their contrast must be a thin 1px line (fixes arch outlines).  
Based on: [solid-v1.4](solid-v1.4.md)  
Built on this: [solid-v1.6](solid-v1.6.md)  

Not used by any built-in profile (pick it with `--blocks`, `--items` or `--use`).

## What it changes

Compared with solid-v1.4:

| option | solid-v1.4 | solid-v1.5 |
|---|---|---|
| `strong_thin` | `False` | `True` |
